dct_description_sm: Contributors: Bird, Kenneth J.; Geological Survey (U.S.); Haga, Hideyo; Mickey, Michael B.
Publication statement: Menlo Park, Calif. : U.S. Dept. of the Interior, U.S. Geological Survey, 2006.
System requirements: web browser such as Netscape or Internet Explorer; PDF-readable software such as Adobe Acrobat Reader.

This report provides micropaleontologic data and interpretations of the rocks penetrated by 49 wells and 3,134 seismic shot holes distributed among 73 seismic lines. All shot holes and 30 wells are located within the National Petroleum Reserve in Alaska (NPRA); the remaining 19 wells are located adjacent to the NPRA.
dct_title_s: Micropaleontology of selected wells and seismic shot holes, northern Alaska
